title: World Cup 2026 Final Set: Argentina vs Spain After Dramatic Semifinal Wins
excerpt: Messi's two assists spark an Argentina comeback against England, while Spain shut out France 2-0. The world's top two ranked teams meet in Sunday's final in New Jersey, with Messi chasing history at 39.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Argentina beat England 2-1 in a dramatic semifinal comeback; Spain defeated France 2-0.
  • Lionel Messi leads the Golden Boot with 8 goals — 21 career World Cup goals, an all-time record.
  • The final: Sunday, July 19, 3 PM ET at New York/New Jersey Stadium.
  • Spain have conceded just one goal in six matches.
  • France vs England in the third-place match on Saturday in Miami.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup final is set: Argentina will face Spain on Sunday, July 19 at New York/New Jersey Stadium, after both teams won their semifinal matches this week in contrasting fashion. ## Argentina's Dramatic Comeback In Wednesday's second semifinal at Atlanta Stadium, Argentina fell behind when England's Anthony Gordon opened the scoring in the 55th minute. What followed was a masterclass in tournament composure from the defending champions. Lionel Messi, playing in his sixth World Cup at age 39, delivered two assists in the final half hour. Enzo Fernandez equalised before Lautaro Martinez struck the winner in the 92nd minute to complete a 2-1 comeback, according to [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/soccer/spain-vs-argentina-2026-world-cup-final). England manager Thomas Tuchel acknowledged the collapse: "We got too passive after we scored, conceded too many chances. I take responsibility," [he told reporters](https://www.thetimes.com/sport/football/england-vs-argentina-world-cup-2026-live-score-result). After Gordon's goal, England managed just 12% possession through the remainder of the match — a staggering drop that underscored Argentina's ability to seize control of games when it matters most. ## Spain's Dominant Run In Tuesday's first semifinal in Dallas, Spain dispatched France 2-0 in a display that highlighted why they have been the tournament's most complete side. Mikel Oyarzabal converted from the penalty spot before Pedro Porro added a second in the second half, [per MLS Soccer](https://www.mlssoccer.com/news/spain-vs-argentina-2026-world-cup-final). Spain have conceded just one goal in their entire tournament run — a solitary strike from Belgium in the quarterfinal. Their defensive record is the best of any team in the competition. Led by 19-year-old Barcelona sensation Lamine Yamal, the 2024 European champions have steadily improved through the knockout rounds after an opening draw against Cape Verde. They followed that with a 4-0 rout of Saudi Arabia, then beat Austria, Portugal, Belgium and France in succession. ## Messi's Record-Breaking Run Messi leads the Golden Boot race with eight goals in the tournament, pushing his career World Cup tally to 21 — the most by any player in the history of the competition. He also leads the tournament with 12 career World Cup assists. At 39, Messi has confirmed this will be his final World Cup. A victory on Sunday would make Argentina the first team to win three consecutive major tournament titles (2021 Copa America, 2022 World Cup, 2024 Copa America) along with the World Cup defence. ## The Road to the Final According to [TNT Sports](https://www.tntsports.co.uk/football/world-cup/2026/story/fifa-world-cup-2026-all-results.shtml), the full bracket: **Spain's path:** Drew Cape Verde 0-0, beat Saudi Arabia 4-0, beat Uruguay 1-0, beat Austria 3-0 (R32), beat Portugal 1-0 (R16), beat Belgium 2-1 (QF), beat France 2-0 (SF). **Argentina's path:** Beat Algeria 3-0, beat Austria 3-1, beat Jordan 3-1, beat Cape Verde 3-2 AET (R32), beat Egypt 3-2 AET (R16), beat Switzerland 3-1 AET (QF), beat England 2-1 (SF). France and England will contest the third-place match on Saturday at Miami Stadium. **The final kicks off at 3 PM ET (12 PM PT) on Sunday, July 19.** It will be broadcast on FOX in the US.
